# Building scope, scope:pp_pclose_pt = the pop type the asking plan's building needs: the building's workers are
# of that type (peasants are checked beside it).
pp_pclose_pt_match = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = burghers
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:burghers
		}
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = clergy
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:clergy
		}
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = laborers
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:laborers
		}
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = nobles
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:nobles
		}
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = slaves
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:slaves
		}
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = soldiers
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:soldiers
		}
		AND = {
			building_pop_type = tribesmen
			scope:pp_pclose_pt = pop_type:tribesmen
		}
	}
}
